fullDescription: Renders the default user profile overview with profile metadata, popular repository cards, annual contribution heatmap, activity heading, and selectable contribution year.

Provides the reusable GitHubDashboard default-state composition along with repository cards, split action buttons, searchable repository navigation, prompt input, filter control, and dismissible event panel. It accepts a serializable mode prop and can be reused for dashboard states.

Provides a reusable GitHubProfile default-state composition and ProfileHeader with selectable profile tabs, repository data cards, a contribution heatmap, follow button state, and selectable years. The profile accepts mode, repository, and contribution count props for presentational reuse.
